999008199.text:
ふむ、ノルト州の大森林地帯……か。
極夜の錬金党の本拠地があった場所だな

localizations.en: Hmm, the great forests of the Nord... This is where the Polar Night Alchemists had their headquarters.

999008199.text: ですが、こちらの方面はまだ調べていませんでしたね

localizations.en: We haven't investigated this area yet, have we?

999008199.text:
調べ尽くすには広すぎる場所ですもの。
わたくしもこちらに足を踏み入れるのは初めてですわ

localizations.en: It's simply too vast to explore completely. Even I have never set foot in this part before.

999008199.text:
物の本によれば、希少素材の宝庫である一方、
危険な魔物の巣窟でもあるとか

localizations.en: According to the texts, while it's a treasure trove of rare materials, it's also a den of dangerous monsters.

999008199.text:
ですが、今のララ様の美しさにも強さにも
かなう敵などおりません！

localizations.en: But no foe can match our queen's grace and might!

999008199.text:
ふふ、当然ですわ。何人たりとも
わたくしたちの行く手の邪魔はさせませんわよ

localizations.en: Hehe, naturally. No one shall stand in our way.

999008199.text: そのとーり！　どんな魔物だろうと蹴散らしてみせる！

localizations.en: That's right! We'll knock down any monster that crosses our path!
My, that's quite the bold statement.

999008199.text: 大きなことはいいこと！
ふふ。では、気を抜かずに進みましょう

localizations.en: Hehe. Well then, let's proceed with caution.
